title: Find the duplicate element in an array
hint: A HashSet lets you detect a repeat in a single pass.
interviewFollowUp: Can you solve this in O(1) extra space using Floyd's cycle detection?

title: Two Sum — find a pair of elements in an array whose sum equals a target value
hint: Store each number's index in a HashMap as you scan, and check whether target minus the current value has already been seen.

title: Find all pairs, not just one, whose sum equals a target value
hint: Count occurrences in a HashMap or sort and use two pointers, skipping duplicates, so every distinct pair is collected without repeating.

title: Find the common elements between two arrays
hint: Put one array into a HashSet, then scan the other and keep elements found in the set; a set result avoids duplicates.

title: Rotate an array to the right by k steps, in place
hint: Reverse the whole array, then reverse the first k elements and the remaining n-k separately; take k modulo n first.

title: Kadane's Algorithm — find the maximum sum contiguous subarray
hint: Keep a running sum that resets to the current element whenever it drops below it, and track the best sum seen so far.

title: Product of Array Except Self — without using division
hint: Make two passes: store prefix products going left to right, then multiply by a running suffix product going right to left.

title: Merge overlapping intervals from a list of [start, end] pairs
hint: Sort intervals by start, then walk through them, extending the last merged interval's end when the next start overlaps it.

title: Move all zeroes to the end of an array, keeping the order of other elements
hint: Use a write pointer for the next non-zero slot; copy non-zeros forward as you scan, then fill the remainder with zeroes.

title: Find the best time to buy and sell a stock to maximize profit
hint: Scan once tracking the minimum price so far, and at each day compare the current price minus that minimum against the best profit.
